Full-time

**About the Role**

We are looking for a Senior Data Engineer to design, build, and operate reliable data pipelines and orchestration frameworks, and to enable AI-driven products and workflows on top of them. You will own the data flow from ingestion to consumption, set engineering standards for the team, and work closely with analytics, data science, and ML teams.

•Support retrieval-based AI solutions, including embedding pipelines and vector databases.

•Implement data quality checks, validation, lineage, and documentation.

•Apply security, privacy, and compliance best practices to data handling.

•Lead design reviews and code reviews, and mentor junior and mid-level engineers.

•Translate business requirements into technical solutions and communicate with stakeholders.

**Required Qualification**

•8-10 years of professional experience in data engineering or a closely related field.

•Strong proficiency in Python and advanced SQL.

•Proven experience building and maintaining production data pipelines at scale.

•Hands-on experience with at least one orchestration tool

•Experience with big data and processing frameworks

•Experience with cloud platforms and their data services.

•Solid understanding of data warehousing and lakehouse concepts, data modeling, and tools.

•Working knowledge of AI/ML workflows and tools, including LLM APIs, embeddings, and vector databases.

•Experience with version control, CI/CD, and infrastructure as code (e.g., Git, Terraform, Docker).

•Strong problem-solving, communication, and stakeholder management skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**

•Experience building RAG or agent-based solutions in production.

•Knowledge of data governance, cataloging, and lineage tools.

•Cloud or data platform certifications.

•Experience in healthcare industry.

•Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.

title: IT Solutions Analyst
description:
**This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an IT Solutions Analyst based in India.**
In this role, you will serve as the functional and technical link between business stakeholders and the ServiceNow platform, delivering scalable solutions that enhance business operations. You will design, configure, develop, and maintain applications across Customer Service Management (CSM), Manufacturing Commercial Operations (MCO), and Sales and Order Management (SOM). Working closely with sales, customer care, manufacturing, and IT teams, you will translate complex business requirements into efficient digital workflows and integrations. You will also contribute to AI-powered automation, platform enhancements, and enterprise system connectivity. Beyond solution development, you will oversee production support, troubleshoot technical issues, and drive continuous improvement. This position offers the opportunity to work with advanced enterprise technologies in a collaborative, Agile, and primarily remote environment.
  
  
Accountabilities
  
  

* Gather, analyze, and document business requirements through stakeholder workshops, interviews, and process mapping involving sales, customer service, manufacturing, and finance teams.
* Translate business needs into functional specifications, user stories, acceptance criteria, and technical solution designs aligned with ServiceNow best practices.
* Evaluate the impact of platform upgrades, new releases, and process changes, prioritizing out-of-the-box (OOTB) solutions over unnecessary customizations.
* Configure, enhance, and support ServiceNow Customer Service Management (CSM), including case management, customer and account data, entitlements, SLAs, Customer Service Portal, Virtual Agent, and knowledge management.
* Develop and maintain Manufacturing Commercial Operations (MCO) and Sales and Order Management (SOM) capabilities, including product and quote catalogs, order capture, fulfillment orchestration, order tracking, and manufacturing workflows.
* Design and develop custom scoped applications using Flow Designer, Workflow Studio, Business Rules, Script Includes, UI Policies, Client Scripts, UI Builder, Workspaces, and Service Portal.
* Build and maintain integrations between ServiceNow and enterprise systems such as Salesforce, ERP, PLM, MES, telephony platforms, on-premise applications, and databases using REST/SOAP APIs, Integration Hub, MID Server, JDBC, and data import sets.
* Implement, configure, and optimize ServiceNow AI capabilities, including Now Assist, AI Agents, Virtual Agent, AI Search, and Build Agent, to improve case resolution, order processing, and agent productivity.
* Develop test plans and test cases, conduct functional and regression testing, and coordinate User Acceptance Testing (UAT) with relevant stakeholders.
* Manage deployments across ServiceNow instances using update sets and application repositories while following established change management, release management, and source-control practices.
* Prepare release notes, technical documentation, training materials, and knowledge articles, and support end-user and super-user training.
* Provide Tier 2 and Tier 3 production support for CSM, MCO, and SOM, including incident management, troubleshooting, root-cause analysis, and permanent issue resolution within agreed SLAs.
* Monitor platform health, data quality, and application performance while proactively identifying process gaps, configuration issues, and opportunities for improvement.
* Support platform upgrades, family release adoption, technical debt reduction, and continuous platform optimization.
* Maintain solution documentation, data models, process flows, and technical specifications while contributing to product backlogs and Agile sprint planning.
* Collaborate with architects, developers, and platform owners to ensure compliance with security standards, access controls (ACLs), data governance, and regulatory requirements.
* Monitor solution adoption and business performance through dashboards and Performance Analytics, tracking KPIs such as case resolution time, order cycle time, and SLA attainment.
* Mentor junior analysts, share technical knowledge, and contribute to the development of ServiceNow best practices across the organization.

**Requirements**

* Bachelor's degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Engineering, Business, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
* At least 5 years of hands-on experience working with ServiceNow as a platform analyst, administrator, or developer.
* Demonstrated implementation and production support experience in at least two of the following ServiceNow modules: Customer Service Management (CSM), Manufacturing Commercial Operations (MCO), and Sales and Order Management (SOM).
* Proven experience developing custom scoped applications on the ServiceNow platform, from requirements gathering and solution design through deployment and ongoing support.
* Experience supporting production ServiceNow environments, including incident management, root-cause analysis, platform upgrades, and release cycles.
* ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA) certification and ServiceNow Certified Application Developer (CAD) certification are required.
* ServiceNow Certified Implementation Specialist – Customer Service Management (CSM) and Sales and Order Management (SOM) certifications are preferred.
* Certifications in Manufacturing Commercial Operations (MCO) or equivalent manufacturing-focused ServiceNow credentials are a strong advantage.
* Strong understanding of the ServiceNow data model, tables, access control lists (ACLs), roles, CMDB, and customer service data structures.
* Proficiency in JavaScript (server-side and client-side), Glide APIs, Flow Designer, Workflow Studio, and scoped application development.
* Practical experience integrating ServiceNow with Salesforce, on-premise applications, databases, and enterprise platforms using REST/SOAP APIs, SQL, JDBC, Integration Hub, MID Server, import sets, and transform maps.
* Hands-on knowledge of ServiceNow AI capabilities, including Now Assist skills for CSM and SOM, case and order summarization, resolution notes, knowledge generation, Virtual Agent, AI Search, and Now Assist Skill Kit (NASK).
* Working knowledge of agentic AI capabilities, including configuring and governing AI Agents, developing agentic workflows, selecting model providers, and managing Now Assist administration, licensing, and governance guardrails.
* Experience with Customer Service Portal, Service Portal, UI Builder, and Workspaces, particularly Customer Service Workspace.
* Understanding of business processes such as order-to-cash, quote-to-order, entitlement management, warranty management, and contract management.
* Familiarity with Agile methodologies, including Scrum and SAFe, user story development, and tools such as ServiceNow Agile Development, Jira, or Azure DevOps.
* Ability to prepare functional specifications, test cases, process documentation, and technical presentations for both technical and non-technical audiences.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a focus on identifying root causes and implementing sustainable solutions rather than temporary workarounds.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to facilitate workshops and explain complex technical concepts to business stakeholders.
* Strong stakeholder management skills and the ability to balance competing priorities across commercial, customer service, manufacturing, and IT teams.
* Customer-focused mindset, with an emphasis on measurable business outcomes, solution adoption, and service quality.
* Self-motivated, detail-oriented, and comfortable working independently in a fast-paced Agile environment.
* Ability to collaborate effectively with onshore and offshore development teams.

**Additional Advantages**

* Hands-on experience with MCO and manufacturing commercial processes, including contracts, pricing, and order-to-delivery visibility.
* Experience with Configure, Price, Quote (CPQ) solutions such as ServiceNow SOM, Salesforce CPQ, or Oracle CPQ, including product catalogs, pricing rules, quote-to-order workflows, and ERP integrations.
* Additional certifications in ServiceNow Certified Technical Architect (CTA), Integration Hub, Performance Analytics, Now Assist, Generative AI, Agentic AI, or Predictive Intelligence.
* Experience developing custom AI skills and AI Agents or using Build Agent to create intelligent workflows.
* Experience integrating ServiceNow with ERP platforms such as Oracle Fusion, CRM systems such as Salesforce, and PLM or MES solutions.
* Familiarity with CI/CD processes, Git integration, source control, and Automated Test Framework (ATF).
* Exposure to data analytics and visualization tools such as Power BI or Tableau.
* Previous experience coordinating projects or mentoring junior team members.

**Working Conditions**

* Primarily remote working arrangement, with occasional business travel.
* Participation in an on-call rotation for critical production incidents.
* Availability for occasional after-hours support during releases, upgrades, and maintenance activities.
* Candidates must be based locally within the position's designated location. Relocation assistance and visa sponsorship are not available.

* Opportunity to work with advanced ServiceNow enterprise solutions and AI-powered technologies.
* Exposure to large-scale digital transformation projects across customer service, manufacturing, and commercial operations.
* Opportunity to develop expertise in ServiceNow CSM, MCO, SOM, integrations, and agentic AI.

* Collaborative working environment involving international stakeholders and cross-functional technical teams.
* Opportunities to contribute to strategic IT initiatives and continuous improvement projects.

title: HR Solution Architect
description:
**Hiring: HR Solution Architect**

**Location:**
Gurugram, India

**Work Model:**
Hybrid

**Employment Type:**
Permanent

**Role Overview**

We are looking for an experienced
**HR Solution Architect**
to bridge HR strategy, business processes, employee experience and enterprise technology architecture.

The ideal candidate will translate complex HR business requirements into scalable, secure and effective technology solutions. This role requires a problem-first approach, evaluating multiple solution options across HR platforms, process redesign, enterprise integrations, automation and AI-enabled solutions.

You will work closely with HR leadership, enterprise architects, technology teams, data, security and business stakeholders to define solution strategies, architecture roadmaps and technology recommendations that deliver measurable business value.

The role requires a combination of strong HR technology knowledge, enterprise solutioning capabilities, integration architecture understanding and awareness of emerging AI capabilities.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. HR Solution Architecture & Process Design**

* Lead business discovery, requirement assessment, process mapping and solution design engagements.
* Evaluate existing HR processes and identify opportunities for simplification, digitisation and automation.
* Design end-to-end HR workflows covering recruitment, onboarding, core HR, employee services, performance, learning, compensation and workforce management.
* Evaluate technology options based on business value, scalability, complexity, security, cost and long-term sustainability.
* Develop solution blueprints, architecture recommendations, business cases and design documentation.

**2. HR Technology & AI Solutioning**

* Evaluate opportunities to leverage AI, Generative AI, intelligent automation and AI agents across HR processes.
* Assess whether business requirements are best addressed through existing HCM platforms, enterprise AI solutions, third-party tools, custom applications or hybrid approaches.
* Contribute to the design of AI-enabled HR assistants, conversational solutions, intelligent workflows and agent-based applications.
* Define proof-of-concept approaches, success measures, validation criteria and deployment considerations.
* Ensure appropriate human oversight, escalation mechanisms and accountability in AI-enabled HR workflows.

**3. Enterprise Integration & Architecture**

* Define integration approaches across HR applications, enterprise platforms, APIs, data services and automation solutions.
* Provide architectural guidance on REST APIs, event-driven integrations, middleware, data pipelines and system interoperability.
* Promote reusable integration patterns and scalable architecture while reducing fragmented systems and point-to-point dependencies.
* Partner with enterprise, cloud, security, data and infrastructure architects to ensure alignment with technology standards.
* Contribute to architecture reviews, solution governance and technical decision-making.

**4. HR Data Governance & Responsible AI**

* Ensure employee and candidate data is handled securely and in accordance with privacy, compliance and regulatory requirements.
* Incorporate data protection, access controls, data minimisation, retention, auditability and transparency into solution designs.
* Evaluate AI-related risks such as bias, inaccurate outputs, confidentiality, explainability and inappropriate automation.
* Ensure human review and appropriate controls for sensitive HR decisions involving recruitment, compensation, performance and employee matters.
* Collaborate with HR, IT, Cyber Security, Legal, Risk and Data Governance teams.

**5. Stakeholder Management & Technology Roadmaps**

* Work closely with HR leaders, business stakeholders, product managers, technology teams and external vendors.
* Translate business challenges and technical architecture decisions into clear recommendations for senior stakeholders.
* Lead solution workshops, design discussions and cross-functional alignment sessions.
* Develop current-state and future-state architecture roadmaps aligned with HR and enterprise technology strategy.
* Identify opportunities to simplify the HR technology landscape, improve employee experience and increase operational efficiency.

**Required Skills & Experience**

**Experience & Education**

* 12+ years of experience in HR technology, enterprise technology, solution architecture, product management, technical consulting or a related field.
* At least 7 years of experience in solution architecture, technical roadmaps, enterprise solution design or cross-platform technology strategy.
* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology or a related discipline. Relevant equivalent experience may also be considered.

**HR Technology & Functional Expertise**

* Strong understanding of end-to-end HR processes, including Talent Acquisition, Onboarding, Core HCM, Workforce Management, Performance Management, Learning, Compensation and Employee Services.
* Experience with HR technology transformation, HRIS implementations, process redesign and enterprise HR platforms.
* Ability to identify business and process challenges before recommending technology solutions.

**Solution & Integration Architecture**

* Strong understanding of enterprise solution architecture, cloud platforms, APIs, integration patterns and data architecture fundamentals.
* Exposure to REST APIs, event-driven architecture, middleware, data pipelines, identity management and security principles.
* Ability to develop conceptual and logical solution architectures and assess technical trade-offs.
* Understanding of Agile, DevOps, prototyping and software development lifecycle practices.

**AI, Automation & Responsible AI**

* Practical understanding of Generative AI, LLM-based applications, AI agents, intelligent automation and enterprise AI platforms.
* Familiarity with AI orchestration, conversational solution design, prompt engineering or agent interoperability.
* Understanding of Responsible AI principles, including fairness, bias mitigation, reliability, transparency, explainability, privacy and human oversight.
* Ability to assess AI use cases and identify appropriate governance, controls and monitoring requirements.

**Stakeholder & Consulting Skills**

* Excellent communication, presentation, problem-solving and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to engage confidently with senior HR and IT leaders and communicate complex technical concepts in business language.
* Strong consulting, facilitation, negotiation and influencing skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with HR platforms such as SAP SuccessFactors, Workday, ServiceNow HRSD, UKG, Phenom or similar enterprise solutions.
* Exposure to enterprise architecture and application portfolio management tools such as LeanIX.
* TOGAF or equivalent enterprise architecture certification.
* Experience with AI agent orchestration frameworks, conversational AI or enterprise AI solution design.
* Familiarity with enterprise data platforms and HR data governance.

**What Success Looks Like**

* Business problems are clearly understood and process improvements are considered before technology selection.
* HR technology recommendations are scalable, secure, cost-effective and aligned with enterprise architecture.
* AI-enabled HR solutions are designed with appropriate governance, transparency and human oversight.
* HR applications, integrations, data services and AI capabilities work together as a connected ecosystem.
* Architecture recommendations enable informed decisions and measurable improvements in employee experience and HR operations.

**Additional Information**

* Primary work location: Gurugram, India.
* Work model: Hybrid.
* Working hours: Regular business hours, with flexibility to collaborate with global stakeholders across time zones.
* Travel: Occasional travel may be required.
